# Harbor Hazmat

> Training for marinas, ports and marine terminals: 40-hour oil spill HAZWOPER, booms, spill prevention, awareness, incident command and gas detection, with spill reporting and facility response guides.

Harbor Hazmat (https://marine.hazwoperosha.us/) sells online training from HAZWOPER OSHA Training, LLC (https://hazwoper-osha.com/). Courses are 100% online and self-paced, and each includes a certificate of completion. Prices are per seat; seats for a whole crew can be bought in one checkout. Phone +1-866-429-6742, email info@hazwoper-osha.com.

## When to use this site

- Use it when someone needs Booms, Spill Prevention, 40 Hr Oil Spill, Awareness or related training, wants to compare those courses, or needs to know what a regulation requires them to take.
- Each course page lists the length, the price per seat, the regulation it covers, what it teaches and who it's for.
- To enroll, open a course's enroll link below. It opens the checkout on that page; payment is by card through Stripe. For an invoice or purchase order, call +1-866-429-6742 or email info@hazwoper-osha.com.
- Every page is also served as Markdown: send `Accept: text/markdown`, or add `.md` to the path (https://marine.hazwoperosha.us/index.md).

## Courses

- [Spill Response Equipment - Absorbent & Containment Booms](https://marine.hazwoperosha.us/courses/spill-response-equipment-absorbent-and-containment-booms): $24.99 per seat, 1 Hour, 40 CFR 112 / 29 CFR 1910.120. Deploying absorbent and containment boom from docks and boats. Enroll: https://marine.hazwoperosha.us/courses/spill-response-equipment-absorbent-and-containment-booms?buy=478
- [OSHA Spill Prevention and Response Safety Training](https://marine.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-spill-prevention-and-response-safety-training): $29.99 per seat, 2 Hours, 29 CFR 1910.120 / 40 CFR 112. Preventing spills at fuel docks and transfers. Enroll: https://marine.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-spill-prevention-and-response-safety-training?buy=416
- [OSHA 40 Hour HAZWOPER for Oil & Gas Spill Response](https://marine.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-40-hour-hazwoper-for-oil-and-gas-spill-response): $249.99 per seat, 40 Hours, 29 CFR 1910.120(e) / 1926.65(e). The 40-hour HAZWOPER for oil spill response crews. Enroll: https://marine.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-40-hour-hazwoper-for-oil-and-gas-spill-response?buy=591
- [OSHA 4-Hour HAZWOPER First Responder Awareness Level Training](https://marine.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-4-hour-hazwoper-first-responder-awareness-level-training): $61.99 per seat, 4 Hours, 29 CFR 1910.120(q)(6)(i). Recognize a release, get clear and report it. Enroll: https://marine.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-4-hour-hazwoper-first-responder-awareness-level-training?buy=1099
- [OSHA 8 Hour HAZWOPER (q) Incident Command Training](https://marine.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-8-hour-hazwoper-q-incident-command-training): $199.99 per seat, 8 Hours, 29 CFR 1910.120(q). Incident command for spill and hazmat incidents. Enroll: https://marine.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-8-hour-hazwoper-q-incident-command-training?buy=593
- [OSHA Air Monitoring and Gas Detection Training](https://marine.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-air-monitoring-and-gas-detection-training): $49.99 per seat, 2 Hours, 29 CFR 1910.120 / 1910.146 / 1910.1000. Gas detection for vessel spaces, tanks and fuel areas. Enroll: https://marine.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-air-monitoring-and-gas-detection-training?buy=1056

## Guides

- [Oil spill at the marina: first response and reporting](https://marine.hazwoperosha.us/guides/oil-spill-first-response-marina): A sheen on the water needs fast action and a phone call. What dock staff should do.
- [Deploying boom from docks and boats](https://marine.hazwoperosha.us/guides/deploying-boom-from-docks-and-boats): Boom holds oil only if it's placed right for the current and tide.
- [Facility response plans and spill training](https://marine.hazwoperosha.us/guides/facility-response-plans-training): Larger oil-handling marine facilities need response plans, trained people and regular drills.
